英国继续教育：人数与学习形式未作答柱状图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 3 页

The chart below shows the number of men and women in further education in Britain in three periods and whether they were studying full-time or part-time.

完整写作 · 英国继续教育：人数与学习形式 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）：按part-time/full-time分组，跨性别和年份作比较。纵轴是thousands，图上非刻度交点的数使用about。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, part-time study was much more common than full-time study among both men and women in all three periods. Female participation increased in both modes, and by 1990/91 women outnumbered men in part-time education, while the numbers studying full-time were similar.

About one million men studied part-time in 1970/71, compared with roughly 750,000 women. Male participation then declined to around 850,000 in 1980/81 before recovering to about 900,000 in 1990/91. The corresponding female figure rose steadily, reaching just over 800,000 in the middle period and approximately 1.1 million in the final one. Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end.

Full-time numbers were considerably smaller. Around 100,000 men followed full-time courses in 1970/71, compared with fewer than 100,000 women. Both figures subsequently increased. Female full-time participation had moved above the male figure by 1980/81, and by 1990/91 the totals for the two sexes were both in the region of a quarter of a million.

纵轴thousands：1000相当于1,000,000人；不能把灰柱1000写成1000人或1000%。

灰柱part-time始终远高于黑柱full-time。男性part-time先降后回升，不能写三期持续上升。

女性part-time最终约1.1 million高于男性约0.9 million；采用图形估读的约数，不把粗图假装精确调查数据。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview横跨两个性别和两种形式。

主体一用part-time的起点差距、转折、终点反转构成比较链。

主体二把较小的full-time群体集中处理。

词语与搭配

outnumbered men：人数超过男性，而非增长率超过男性。

the corresponding female figure：省去重复part-time participation。

in the region of a quarter of a million：粗图估读的稳妥表达。

句子精读

Male participation then declined ... before recovering ... → before后动名词标示先降后升。

Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end. → 总结比较，不添加原因。

广播与电视受众：同一天的双峰比较未作答折线图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 4 页

The graph below shows radio and television audiences throughout the day in 1992.

完整写作 · 广播与电视受众：同一天的双峰比较 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

本次写作任务

保留图中一天的完整时间轴，写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。须写清百分比人群、广播早高峰与电视晚高峰；不能把一天内的时段变化写成年增长。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, radio attracted its largest audience in the morning, while television viewing was concentrated in the evening. Television reached a substantially higher peak than radio, and both media had very small audiences during the early hours of the morning.

At 6 a.m., approximately 5% of the UK population aged over four listened to the radio, while virtually nobody was watching television. Radio listening rose rapidly to a peak of about 27% at around 8 a.m. It then generally declined through the day, despite a modest recovery in the late afternoon. By late evening, the figure had fallen to well below 10%, and it approached zero during the night.

Television viewing remained below 10% throughout the morning before rising around lunchtime and overtaking radio early in the afternoon. After a brief period near 15%, the television audience increased sharply in the late afternoon and evening, peaking at roughly 45–47% around 8 p.m. It subsequently dropped steeply, especially after midnight, and was only a few per cent by the following morning.

对象是UK population over 4 years old；百分比不能写成millions。图题范围October–December 1992，横轴6am到次日6am。

广播峰值约27%，电视约45–47%；粗线图允许about，不需要虚构47.3%。

“overtaking radio early in the afternoon”来自两线相交；不能把晚间电视优势扩成全天每时段都更高。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview先比峰值出现时段，再比峰值大小。

广播段按主要升降，不追逐每个小波动。

电视段突出午后反超、晚间最高、午夜后下降。

词语与搭配

was concentrated in the evening：集中发生的时间。

despite a modest recovery：概括主趋势中的小反向变化。

virtually nobody：接近零，不强行写0.0%。

句子精读

It then generally declined ... despite a modest recovery ... → generally给真实波动留空间。

After a brief period near 15%, ... → 介词短语给出第二次明显上涨前的平台。

制砖：并行成形路径与温度阶段未作答制作流程图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 5 页

The diagram below shows the process by which bricks are manufactured for the building industry.

完整写作 · 制砖：并行成形路径与温度阶段 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。保留wire cutter / mould的二选一分支、24–48小时干燥、两档窑温和48–72小时冷却；按工序分段。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, brick manufacture begins with the excavation of clay and ends with the packaging and delivery of the finished product. The material passes through preparation, shaping, drying, heating and cooling, with two alternative methods available for forming individual bricks.

First, clay is dug from the ground by a mechanical digger and placed on a metal grid above a roller. The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. The resulting mixture is then shaped into bricks either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds. These are alternative routes at the same stage, rather than consecutive operations that every brick must undergo.

The newly formed bricks are dried in an oven for 24 to 48 hours. They are then heated in a kiln, initially at a moderate temperature of 200–980°C and subsequently at a higher temperature of 870–1300°C. After this, they spend 48 to 72 hours in a cooling chamber. Finally, the cooled bricks are packaged and loaded for delivery by truck.

原图or连接wire cutter和mould，参考写法用either ... or，不能写先切后入模。

干燥24–48h与冷却48–72h不同；窑炉先200–980°C、后870–1300°C，区间重叠是原图数据，不自行“纠正”。

被动语态描述材料经历：is dug / are added / are dried；无需凭空添加工人或工厂地点。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview起终点加主要加工阶段。

前段写原料准备与成形分支。

后段写热处理、冷却和配送。

词语与搭配

either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds：两种方式保持平行。

initially ... subsequently：区分两档窑温。

the resulting mixture：回指已经加入沙和水的黏土。

句子精读

The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. → 两个被动结构保留明确先后。

They are then heated ... initially ... and subsequently ... → 同一heated谓语承接两个温度阶段。

同题官方考生样本 · Band 8.5 · 1C Script C

优先对照这份同题官方考生稿及考官评语；分数仅属于该原稿。本地参考段落仍为原创教学示范。

官方作答 · 第16页考官评语 · 第17页官方在线原件

先看原样本怎样概括关键阶段，再对照本地短段的分支、时长和温度；8.5仍有概述可改进处。

自行车使用率：年龄比较与百分点差未作答表格 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing — modified large print · PDF 第 4 页

The table below gives information about the percentage of the population by age group in one town who rode a bicycle in June 2011.

完整写作 · 自行车使用率：年龄比较与百分点差 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个比较段（约150–180词），先比较儿童/青少年，再比较成人；指出最低组和60+回升。列出最大性别差距并用percentage points表达。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, cycling was most common among children under ten and least common in the 40–59 age group. Males had higher participation rates than females in every category, although the difference between the sexes was very small among the youngest children.

Among those aged 0–9, 51.3% of males and 50.3% of females rode a bicycle, a gap of just one percentage point. Participation was lower among 10–17-year-olds, at 42.2% for males and 24.6% for females. This group therefore had the largest gender difference, amounting to 17.6 percentage points, with the male figure considerably higher than the female one.

The proportions were smaller in both adult groups below sixty. For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively, falling to 12.3% and 8.0% among 40–59-year-olds. However, the figures rose again in the oldest category: 18.5% of men and 13.2% of women aged sixty or above cycled. Thus, participation did not simply decrease continuously across the age groups.

这是June 2011单月横截面：年龄组之间差异不证明同一批人随时间减少骑行。

10–17岁差距42.2−24.6=17.6个百分点；0–9岁差距1.0个百分点。

两性最低都是40–59岁，60+均回升；不能写年龄越大比例总是越低。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview同时覆盖年龄高低与性别关系。

前段突出高参与儿童及最大差距青少年。

后段写成人低谷与60+例外。

词语与搭配

a gap of just one percentage point：不是one per cent decrease。

amounting to 17.6 percentage points：补充精确差值。

across the age groups：年龄间比较，避免错误时间趋势。

句子精读

For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively ... → 顺序沿用前段male/female。

However, the figures rose again in the oldest category ... → rose描述相邻年龄组数值变化，最后一句明确并非持续时间变化。

练习

Task 1 · 折线图Task 1 · 流程图Task 1 · 平面图
Task 1 · 折线图 四行业就业
完整写作 · 美国四行业就业：峰值、交叉与最终排名 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

根据原图作答。

单位：million jobs。年份依次为 1960、1980、2000、2020。

Manufacturing：15、20、约17、13；Retail：6、10、15、16；Agriculture：6、3、3、2；Healthcare：2、5、11、16。

The graph shows employment in four sectors of the US economy from 1960 to 2020.

选出可由原图支持的一句。

  • A Manufacturing lost seven million jobs between 1960 and 2020.
  • B Manufacturing ended two million jobs below its initial level, despite an earlier rise.
  • C Healthcare employment increased sixteenfold over the period.
  • D Agricultural employment fell during every interval shown.

写 45–65 个英文词，比较 healthcare 和 retail 的绝对增量、相对增幅及最终水平。不要把岗位数写成就业占比。

答案

1. B。
2. 示例：Healthcare employment rose from two million to sixteen million, adding fourteen million jobs and reaching eight times its initial level. Retail added ten million jobs, growing from six million to sixteen million, approximately 2.7 times its starting figure. The two sectors therefore finished at the same level, despite markedly different growth rates.

再练一次

仍用这张图，写两句 overview，不列出逐年数字；必须同时呈现制造业的主导地位变化和农业的整体走势。

答案

示例：Manufacturing was initially the largest employer, but both retail and healthcare had overtaken it by the end of the period. Agriculture declined overall and remained the smallest sector in 2020.

选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 1 · Task 1

Task 1 · 流程图 砖块制造
完整写作 · 制砖：并行成形路径与温度阶段 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

描述图中实际显示的顺序。

按图中箭头作答。图示数值：干燥 24–48 小时；中温窑 200–980°C；高温窑 870–1300°C；冷却 48–72 小时。

The diagram presents the manufacture of bricks for construction.

把下句改写为 35–50 个英文词，保留真实流程，写到干燥结束：After being mixed with sand and water, the clay is cut with a wire cutter and then pressed into moulds before being heated at 200–980°C in the drying oven.

只根据图示，哪一句成立？

  • A Every brick passes through both shaping methods.
  • B The complete manufacturing process takes no more than five days.
  • C Drying and cooling together account for between 72 and 120 hours, excluding all other stages.
  • D The minimum temperature in the second kiln stage exceeds the maximum in the first.
答案

1. 示例：After sand and water have been added, the clay mixture is shaped into bricks either with a wire cutter or in moulds. The newly formed bricks are then placed in a drying oven for between 24 and 48 hours.
2. C。

再练一次

用两句英文描述干燥之后、包装之前的流程。写出两组温度和冷却时间，不编写图中未给出的加热时长。

答案

The dried bricks pass through a kiln at a moderate temperature of 200–980°C and then a high-temperature stage of 870–1300°C. They are subsequently cooled in a chamber for 48–72 hours.

选材来源 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · Task 1C · 在线来源

Task 1 · 平面图 学院咖啡厅改造
完整写作 · 学院咖啡厅改造：保留设施与功能替换 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

根据两张平面图作答。

The plans show a college café before its redesign and at present.

写 55–75 个英文词，描述两间原 staff dining rooms 的去向，并对比厨房、厕所和中央座位区。

修改这段文字中所有与图不符或缺少依据的内容，保留能由图支持的变化：The kitchen was moved to the south, while all the indoor tables were removed. A coffee bar replaced the kitchen. The old serving area now offers only hot meals, and the café provides outdoor seating beside a barbecue.

答案

1. 示例：The two former staff dining rooms have been converted into two separate food and drink outlets: takeaway food occupies the room on the left, while a coffee bar has replaced the room on the right. In contrast, the kitchen and toilets remain in their original locations, and the central area is still used for tables and chairs.
2. 示例：The kitchen remains in place, and the central indoor seating area has been retained. A coffee bar has replaced the right-hand staff dining room. The former serving area is now labelled 'Hot meals', while outdoor seating and a barbecue have been added.

再练一次

写两句 overview：一句概括食品供应设施的变化，一句对比保留的室内功能与新增的室外空间。不要猜测客流、营业时间或容纳人数。

答案

The café now has a wider range of dedicated food and drink outlets. The kitchen, toilets and central indoor seating area have been retained, while outdoor seating and a barbecue have been added.

选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 2 · Task 1

IELTS / MY STUDY

写作 · Task 2练习

选择一个题组，先作答，再核对答案。

练习

Task 2 · 教育Task 2 · 旅游Task 2 · 城市住房
Task 2 · 教育 小学课堂中的学习与游戏
完整写作 · 小学正式学习与课堂游戏：两个问题分别回应 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

直接回应下面的完整题干。

待改写的立场句（自编）：I agree that play is useful because children enjoy it.

Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning. To what extent do you agree with this opinion? How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom?

把上面的立场句改写为 35–50 个英文词，同时回答两个问题。立场须允许一部分正式教学保留。

写 80–110 个英文词，论证课堂游戏的一项学习价值，并用一个具体课堂活动说明。结尾说明这个活动为什么仍需要教师设计或引导。

答案

1. 示例：I partly agree that primary schools devote too much time to formal instruction. Although direct teaching remains necessary, well-designed classroom play is important because it allows children to apply knowledge and practise cooperation in a meaningful setting.
2. 示例：Classroom play can make an abstract skill easier to use. For example, a teacher could organise a small shop in which pupils take turns buying items with pretend money. Children would have to add prices, calculate change and explain their choices to classmates. This activity gives a practical purpose to calculations that might otherwise remain a page of exercises. However, simply providing toys would not ensure that pupils learnt the intended skill. The teacher would still need to choose suitable prices, observe mistakes and help pupils understand how to correct them.

再练一次

仍回答原题，写 40–55 个英文词的结论。明确区分“正式教学过多”和“正式教学完全无用”，不要新增一个此前未论证的社会问题。

答案

示例：Primary education should therefore place less emphasis on prolonged formal instruction, while preserving direct teaching where it is useful. Structured play deserves a regular place in the classroom because it helps children apply what they learn, but its educational value depends on thoughtful planning and guidance.

选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 4 · Task 2

Task 2 · 旅游 旅游收益与居民成本
完整写作 · 国际旅游：经济收益与社区成本如何比较 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

在给定情境下作答，不把假设写成真实统计。

本练习的假设情境：旅游给当地商店带来收入，但旺季过后部分岗位消失；短租扩张减少了居民可租住房。地方政府可以对短租登记并征收用于公共交通的游客税。

International tourism has brought enormous benefit to many places. At the same time, there is concern about its impact on local inhabitants and the environment. Do the disadvantages of international tourism outweigh the advantages?

写 40–55 个英文词的立场段。不能只写“有好处也有坏处”；比较时须涉及受益者、受损者或影响持续时间。

写 80–110 个英文词，比较商店收入与居民住房成本。结尾直接回答哪一方更重要，以及这个判断依赖什么条件。

答案

1. 示例：In the situation described, the disadvantages outweigh the advantages if tourism income mainly reaches businesses while residents face lasting housing pressure. Temporary increases in trade cannot by themselves justify a continuing loss of affordable homes. Effective regulation could, however, change that balance.
2. 示例：Tourism may increase sales in local shops, but this benefit does not necessarily reach residents who must pay higher rents. The jobs created may also disappear after the main holiday season, whereas the conversion of homes into short-term accommodation can affect housing throughout the year. In this case, I would give greater weight to the lasting pressure on residents than to a temporary rise in commercial income. The balance could become more favourable if registration limits the loss of residential housing and visitor taxes finance services used by local people.

再练一次

把情境改为：短租得到有效控制，游客税确实改善了居民交通。用 35–50 个英文词说明原结论如何调整；不得声称旅游已经没有环境成本。

答案

示例：With effective controls on short-term rentals and visible improvements in local transport, the economic benefits would be more likely to outweigh the disadvantages. However, that judgement would still depend on whether visitor activity placed manageable pressure on the environment.

选材来源 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · Task 2B · 在线来源

Task 2 · 城市住房 高层住宅是否是最佳方案
完整写作 · 高层住宅是否是城市住房的最佳方案 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

围绕原题中的“best way”作答。

待改写句（自编）：Tall buildings contain more homes, so they are the best solution everywhere and will make housing affordable.

The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

将上面的句子改写为 35–50 个英文词。保留高层住宅的一项优势，但不给出题干未能支持的必然结果。

写 80–110 个英文词：在土地紧张的城市里，将高层建设与“改造现有空置建筑”比较。选择一个判断标准，形成有条件的明确立场。

答案

1. 示例：Tall apartment blocks can provide many homes on a limited area of land, making them useful in densely populated cities. However, additional supply does not automatically make housing affordable, and high-rise construction may not be the best option in every neighbourhood.
2. 示例：Where suitable vacant buildings already exist, converting them into homes may provide accommodation sooner than constructing new towers. On a short-term delivery criterion, conversion could therefore be the better option, provided the buildings are safe and reasonably inexpensive to adapt. However, the supply of suitable vacant property is limited, and conversion cannot be assumed to meet all future demand. I would support high-rise development where land is scarce and existing buildings cannot supply enough homes, rather than treating it as the best response to every housing shortage.

再练一次

写 35–50 个英文词的结论。明确同意程度，并保留“新增住房数量”和“住房可负担性”的区别。

答案

家庭与儿童：财富是否决定成年应对能力

家庭与儿童：财富是否决定成年应对能力

完整原题

Children who are brought up in families that do not have large amounts of money are better prepared to deal with the problems of adult life than children brought up by wealthy parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

导读

题目比较两类家庭中的孩子应对成年问题的准备程度。贫穷与富裕是条件；独立性、预算取舍、指导和机会才是可解释的机制。下面是本地编写的两段主体参考，不是完整作文或官方高分稿。可对照同一官方 PDF 第 21 页的 Script C，并读第 22 页的 Band 8.5 考官评语，比较立场、理由和概括范围；该分数仅属于官方考生稿。

参考主体段

Children in families with limited money may gain useful experience of making choices under constraints. If a household cannot afford every desired purchase, a child may have to save gradually, distinguish needs from wants and accept that one decision rules out another. Shared responsibilities can also encourage practical independence. These experiences resemble some of the budgeting and prioritising required in adult life. They provide a plausible reason why growing up without abundant resources could help a person cope with certain financial problems later on.

However, I do not think family wealth alone determines how well someone is prepared. Persistent financial insecurity can create stress and restrict access to education or supportive activities, leaving children with fewer resources for future challenges. Conversely, wealthy parents can require their children to manage an allowance, contribute to household tasks and take responsibility for mistakes. Such practices may develop the same judgment and resilience without serious deprivation. I therefore reject the general comparison in the question: preparation depends more on the responsibilities, guidance and opportunities children receive than on whether their parents have a large income.

逐段解释

没有把may写成all poor children：有限预算可能培养技能，但严重匮乏也会限制机会。

对比对象始终是两类家庭中的孩子及成年应对能力，不转成贫富差距政策文章。

第二段以同样责任训练可存在于富裕家庭反驳“财富决定论”，给出明确不同意。

练习：先找出第一段的条件词may、could，再找第二段的反例。参考答案：有限预算可能培养选择能力，但压力和机会不足会削弱准备；富裕家庭也能通过责任与家务培养判断。因此无法只凭收入推出更充分的准备。

假设一个渔场已有捕捞上限，但部分渔船隐瞒渔获。用 60–80 个英文词写一项与这个问题直接对应的措施，说明执行方式与预期作用。不要写成全面禁止所有捕鱼。

完成后核对写作示例

Authorities could require boats to record their catches and compare these records with inspections at landing sites. Targeted checks would make it harder to hide catches, while proportionate penalties could discourage repeated violations. The fishing rate is now within the permitted range, but the stock has not yet reached its recovery target. Managers should continue monitoring the population and adjust the recovery measures if the evidence indicates that further action is needed.

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Tall apartment blocks can make an important contribution where urban land is scarce. By placing many homes on the same site, a city can accommodate more residents without continually expanding into surrounding farmland. A development near an existing railway station may also allow more households to reach jobs without long car journeys. These benefits support the use of high-rise housing in well-connected districts. They are especially relevant when the alternative is low-density construction that provides relatively few homes on valuable central land.

However, building upwards is not automatically the best response to every housing shortage. If the new flats are unaffordable, an increase in the total housing supply may do little for families who need reasonably priced accommodation. A large tower can also add pressure to schools, water systems and public transport if these services are not expanded. I would therefore favour tall buildings as one part of a wider strategy that also renovates empty properties and provides affordable homes. Their value depends on location, price and supporting infrastructure, rather than height alone.

题眼是best way，不只是a useful way。第二段用可负担性与配套条件检验“最佳”的范围。

第一段链条：同一地块更多住房→少向农地扩张；交通站点例子用may，不伪装统计研究。

两段最后形成“有条件赞成”：认可高层的贡献，同时不支持它作为所有城市的唯一最佳办法。

篇章结构

优势机制—条件化例子—回扣城市土地约束。

限制条件—影响—明确程度立场。

词语与搭配

where urban land is scarce：限定论据适用地点。

do little for families who ...：解释新增供给为何不必然解决可负担问题。

one part of a wider strategy：表达有条件赞成。

句子精读

If the new flats are unaffordable, an increase ... may do little ... → 条件句直接检验题目的“provide enough homes”。

Their value depends on ... rather than height alone. → Their指tall buildings，结尾仍围绕建筑方案。

Those who question the importance of theatres and cinemas can point to the convenience of online entertainment. Viewers can choose what to watch and when to watch it, without paying for transport or arranging an evening around a fixed screening time. Online access may be particularly valuable to people living far from major cultural venues or caring for children at home. For these audiences, a subscription can offer a practical alternative to frequent visits. This makes the claim that physical venues are less necessary understandable, especially when the main aim is simply to see a film.

Nevertheless, I believe these venues retain functions that a personal screen cannot fully reproduce. Economically, a performance supports performers, technicians and other staff, while audiences may also spend money in nearby businesses. Culturally, theatres can stage local stories and create a shared encounter between performers and spectators. Even in a cinema, an audience experiences a film together rather than as separate individuals at home. Online services can therefore widen access without removing the value of physical venues. The two forms can coexist, serving different circumstances and offering different kinds of participation.

第一段真正解释第一方观点：选择时间、出行成本、照顾孩子与地域可达性；没有直接贴标签后马上反驳。

第二段分别回应economically与culturally：岗位/周边消费与本地故事/共同体验。

The two forms can coexist, serving ... and offering ... → 两个分词补充共存的理由。

A compulsory period away from normal university classes can create real difficulties. Studying abroad may involve travel and accommodation costs, while even a local work placement can reduce the time available for paid employment. Students with caring responsibilities may find these demands particularly difficult. Universities also need enough suitable placements; an experience consisting only of routine administrative work would offer limited educational value. These drawbacks matter because the proposal applies to all undergraduate courses, including students and subjects for which arranging an appropriate experience may be challenging.

Even so, I consider the potential advantages greater if institutions offer flexible, well-supported options. A relevant placement allows students to apply classroom ideas to actual workplace problems and obtain feedback from experienced colleagues. Overseas study can expose them to different academic approaches and require greater independence. These gains may continue to influence later study and employment, whereas some financial and practical barriers can be reduced through funding and local placement alternatives. The stronger policy is therefore to provide a meaningful choice between suitable forms of experience, with clear learning goals, rather than require every student to travel abroad.

题目是abroad or placement，末句明确保留本地实习选项；不能误写所有学生必须出国。

outweigh要求比较：长期学习收益与可缓解的成本相对照，而不是两边各列三点后不判断。

承认all courses的实施难题，立场带条件但清楚支持收益更大。

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

I agree that formal learning can receive too much attention when a primary timetable leaves little space for exploration. Direct instruction is necessary for teaching children basic reading and arithmetic, and structured practice helps them become accurate. However, long sequences of worksheets and tests can make pupils focus on producing the expected answer rather than understanding an idea. For example, a child may memorise a calculation procedure but struggle to explain why it works. The problem is therefore not formal teaching itself, but an imbalance that treats written performance as the only useful evidence of learning.

Play has an important complementary role inside the classroom. In a pretend shop, children can practise counting, explain prices and take turns serving one another. The activity joins mathematical language with social interaction, giving a purpose to skills that might otherwise appear abstract. Building a model together can similarly require planning, discussion and revision after something fails. Such activities still need thoughtful guidance from the teacher, so that enjoyment supports a clear learning aim. I would consequently regard purposeful play as a regular part of primary education, rather than a reward offered only after all the serious work is finished.

第一段明确同意的范围：当formal learning挤压exploration时过多，而非主张取消识字算术。

第二段给出课堂内的假想商店与合作模型，回应primary classroom，不跑题到放学后娱乐。

play as well as learn提示两者结合；不是“玩”和“学”完全对立。

an imbalance that ...：把批评集中到比例失衡。

purposeful play：有学习目的的课堂游戏。

The problem is therefore not formal teaching itself, but an imbalance ... → 保持部分同意立场一致。

... so that enjoyment supports a clear learning aim → 目的从句解释教师指导的作用。
